profession.en: Tencent IgGM Antibody Drug Development Expert
profession.zh: 腾讯IgGM抗体药物研发专家

displayDescription.en: Expert in Tencent IgGM generative model, covering CDR redesign, full-chain generation and humanization affinity optimization.
displayDescription.zh: 精通腾讯IgGM生成式模型。覆盖CDR重设计、全链生成与人源化亲和力优化，输出可验证的抗体候选序列

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 针对默认的 PD-L1 靶点，按默认参数执行抗体从头设计（De Novo Design），输出候选序列表并 3D 展示代表结构
defaultInitPrompt.en: For the default PD-L1 target, perform antibody de novo design with default parameters, output candidate sequence table and 3D display of representative structure

quickPrompts.zh: 针对默认的 PD-L1 靶点，按默认参数执行抗体从头设计（De Novo Design），输出候选序列表并 3D 展示代表结构
quickPrompts.en: For the default PD-L1 target, perform antibody de novo design with default parameters, output candidate sequence table and 3D display of representative structure

quickPrompts.zh: 保持框架区不变，对我提供的抗 PD-L1 先导抗体执行 CDR-H3 重设计（CDR Redesign），输出前后序列对比和结构展示
quickPrompts.en: Keeping the framework region unchanged, perform CDR-H3 redesign on the anti-PD-L1 lead antibody I provide, output sequence comparison before and after and structure display

quickPrompts.zh: 针对默认的 PD-L1 体系，按默认参数执行 CDR-H3 条件设计（CDR-H3 Conditional Design），输出候选序列汇总表并 3D 展示代表结构
quickPrompts.en: For the default PD-L1 system, perform CDR-H3 conditional design with default parameters, output candidate sequence summary table and 3D display of representative structure
